purpose: Stream processing pipeline that builds a queryable property graph from network logs.

domain_model.description: Network entities (domains, IPs, URIs, emails, clusters) and their relationships form a property graph stored in per-entity DuckDB files.

bounded_contexts.name: Ingestion
bounded_contexts.description: Parses raw NFS log files into structured messages and publishes to Kafka.

ubiquitous_language.slot: A numbered rawLog file segment from a FortiMail server
ubiquitous_language.day_id: Unix day number (epoch seconds / 86400) used to partition rawLog directories

bounded_contexts.name: Graph
bounded_contexts.description: Consumes Kafka topics to upsert entity nodes, edges, and derived properties into DuckDB.

ubiquitous_language.traffic_history: Per-entity minute-bucketed message count used for trend analysis
ubiquitous_language.derived: Pre-computed aggregate properties refreshed by the derived service
ubiquitous_language.tier: Computation level (A-G) in the derived refresh pipeline, each depends on the previous

bounded_contexts.name: Classification
bounded_contexts.description: ML spam/bot classifier that scores entities and publishes signals to Kafka.

ubiquitous_language.verdict: Weighted spam probability aggregated from multiple signal sources
ubiquitous_language.signal: A single score contribution from one classifier or external source

stack.runtime: 27 Kafka consumer Deployments + REST API + FlightSQL gRPC server + classifier scheduler on a single-node k8s cluster (vandc-66)

groups.name: Data Source
groups.description: Ingests raw NFS logs and publishes structured messages to Kafka.

groups.name: Graph Engine
groups.description: Kafka consumers that build and maintain the entity graph in DuckDB.

groups.name: Query Layer
groups.description: REST API, FlightSQL, and CLI for querying the graph.

groups.name: Classification
groups.description: ML classifier that scores entities for spam probability.

actors.description: FortiMail servers that write rawLog files to the NFS mount.
Security analyst querying the graph via CLI or API for entity investigation.
Grafana dashboards consuming Prometheus metrics and FlightSQL queries.

components.name: Message Producer
components.description: Scans NFS rawLog directories for new slots and publishes parsed messages to the Kafka 'message' topic.

components.name: Entity Extraction
components.description: Consumes parsed messages from Kafka, extracts 14 entity types, and publishes each to dedicated Kafka topics.

components.name: Metadata Archiver
components.description: Archives message metadata and FortiMail device inventory to DuckDB for operational queries.

components.name: Node Consumers
components.description: 12 Kafka consumers that upsert entity nodes (subnet, domain, host, URI, email, text, image, content_template, cluster, score, IP, message) into per-entity DuckDB files.

components.name: Edge Consumers
components.description: 3 Kafka consumers that build relationship edges (emailed_with, association, cluster_member) between entities in DuckDB.

components.name: Enrichment Service
components.description: Enriches domain nodes with WHOIS, certificate transparency, UCLT category, and reachability data from external sources.

components.name: Derived Refresh
components.description: Continuously recomputes aggregate properties across tiers A-G for all entity types, including graph algorithms (community detection).

components.name: GraphDB REST API
components.description: FastAPI server exposing entity lookup, search, graph traversal, and admin endpoints with token-based auth.

components.name: Flight SQL Server
components.description: Arrow Flight SQL gRPC server that exposes unified entity views over MinIO Parquet snapshots for SQL queries.

components.name: GraphDB CLI + SDK
components.description: Click-based CLI and Python library for querying the GraphDB API with disk caching, Loki logging, and multiple output formats.

components.name: Pipeline Sentinel
components.description: Monitors all pipeline processes via HTTP probes and Kafka lag, exporting composite health metrics to Prometheus.

components.name: ML Inference Pipeline
components.description: Loads trained LightGBM models, queries entity features via FlightSQL, and publishes spam probability scores to the score.signal Kafka topic.

components.name: Classifier Scheduler
components.description: Cron-like scheduler that runs inference, training, seeding, and release jobs on configured intervals.

flows.name: Log Ingestion to Graph
flows.description: A rawLog file on NFS becomes parsed messages, then extracted entities, then graph nodes and edges in DuckDB.
flows.trigger: New rawLog slot appears on NFS mount.

steps.action: Scans NFS for new rawLog slots and parses gz files.
steps.data: Parsed message (log_id, headers, IPs, URIs, email addresses).
steps.transform: Raw gzipped log lines become structured Avro records.

steps.action: Extracts 14 entity types from each message and publishes to dedicated topics.
steps.data: Entity records (subnet, domain, URI, email_address, text, image, content_template, cluster, score).
steps.transform: Single message fans out into multiple typed entity records.

steps.action: Upserts entity nodes into per-type DuckDB files with traffic history.
steps.data: Entity rows with properties and traffic counts.
steps.transform: Kafka records become DuckDB rows with upsert-on-conflict semantics.
Co-occurrence in messages becomes weighted graph edges.

flows.name: Derived Property Computation
flows.description: The derived refresh service continuously computes aggregate properties across tiers A through G for all entity types.
flows.trigger: Continuous round-robin loop, Tier G every 6 hours.

steps.action: Queries base DuckDB files for stale entities.
Computes tier A (traffic history), B (message joins), C (reputation), D (multi-hop), E (aggregations), F (static props).
steps.transform: Raw entity data becomes enriched with aggregate properties.

steps.action: Exports derived tables as Parquet snapshots to MinIO for Flight SQL.

flows.name: Entity Query Path
flows.description: An analyst queries the graph via CLI, which calls the REST API, which queries FlightSQL over MinIO Parquet snapshots.

steps.action: Checks disk cache, sends HTTP request to API if miss.
steps.data: Entity type + key or search query.

steps.action: Validates token, checks entity cache, queries FlightSQL pool.
Executes DuckDB query over Parquet views from MinIO.

flows.name: ML Scoring Pipeline
flows.description: The classifier queries entity features via FlightSQL, runs LightGBM inference, and publishes scores to Kafka.
flows.trigger: Scheduler triggers inference job on interval.

steps.action: Launches inference subprocess per entity type.
Queries entity features from FlightSQL, builds feature matrix, runs LightGBM predict.
steps.transform: Entity features become spam probability scores (-1 to +1).

flows.name: Pipeline Health Monitoring
flows.description: Sentinel probes all 25+ processes via HTTP metrics endpoints and Kafka lag, exporting composite health gauges.

steps.action: Queries Kafka exporter for consumer group lag.
Computes composite section health (ingestion, buffers, enrichment, download, storage).

cascade.effect: Cannot publish parsed messages; slots accumulate on NFS.
Consumer loop blocks waiting for broker reconnect.
All graph consumers stall; no new entities ingested.
Serves stale snapshots; queries still work.

failure_modes.impact: No new data enters the graph. Analysts see stale entities. Fully recoverable once Kafka returns.
recovery: Consumers auto-reconnect and resume from last committed offset.

failure_modes.trigger: NFS mount becomes unreachable or stale.

cascade.effect: Returns empty slot list; no new data ingested.

failure_modes.impact: Ingestion stops. Downstream pipeline continues processing existing Kafka data.
recovery: Message producer auto-discovers slots on next scan cycle.

failure_modes.trigger: Multiple processes try to write to the same DuckDB file simultaneously.

cascade.effect: Write retries with exponential backoff (up to 60 retries).
Skips refresh cycle for locked entity type.

failure_modes.impact: Temporary write delays. No data loss — operations retry or skip and catch up next cycle.
recovery: Self-healing: retries succeed after lock released.
If persistent: check for stuck processes holding DuckDB handles.

cascade.effect: Cannot load Parquet snapshots; raises FileNotFoundError.
Queries fail if Flight SQL pool exhausted.
Cannot fetch entity features; inference fails.

failure_modes.impact: All query and ML scoring operations fail. Ingestion pipeline unaffected.
recovery: Flight SQL reconnects automatically on next query.

Single message produces records to 14+ downstream Kafka topics.
Bearer token auth middleware with DuckDB-backed TokenStore.
Round-robin batch refresh of 10K entities per type per cycle.
60-second scan interval polling NFS for new rawLog slots.
LightGBM model loading, feature matrix construction, inference, and Kafka publishing.

gaps.relevance: Multiple external dependencies (Kafka, NFS, MinIO, WHOIS) lack circuit breaker protection.
gaps.recommendation: Add circuit breaker to Kafka producer, NFS access, and MinIO client to prevent cascading failures during sustained outages.

gaps.relevance: HTTP calls to WHOIS/RDAP and MinIO have no retry with backoff.
gaps.recommendation: Add retry with exponential backoff to enrichment HTTP calls and MinIO Parquet uploads.

gaps.relevance: No trace ID propagation across pipeline stages. Messages carry log_id but no W3C trace context.
gaps.recommendation: Propagate trace context through Kafka message headers to enable end-to-end tracing.

gaps.relevance: REST API has token auth but no rate limiting on endpoints.
gaps.recommendation: Add rate limiting middleware to the FastAPI application, at minimum on unauthenticated endpoints (/health, /metrics).

infrastructure.notes: Kafka broker, schema registry, Redis, MinIO config

gaps: No distributed tracing — log_id provides partial correlation but not cross-service trace propagation.
No correlation IDs in structured logs.

recommended.description: No API versioning — all endpoints served at root path without /v1/ prefix.
No rate limiting on any endpoint — authenticated or unauthenticated.
Flight SQL gRPC server has no authentication — any client with network access can run arbitrary SQL.

gateway.notes: Routers delegate to FlightPool/EntityCache service layer; no direct DB queries in handlers.

hexagonal.notes: API routers import stoik server abstractions. Some routers import utils directly for URI parsing.

debt.interpretation: Moderate debt concentrated in missing resilience patterns and observability gaps across a large pipeline.

violations.anti_pattern: No circuit breaker on Kafka producer or MinIO writes
violations.detail: Sustained Kafka or MinIO outage causes unbounded retries without backoff or circuit breaking.

violations.anti_pattern: Flight SQL server has no authentication
violations.detail: Any client with network access can run arbitrary SQL queries against the full graph dataset.

violations.anti_pattern: No distributed tracing across pipeline stages
violations.detail: Messages carry log_id but no W3C trace context; debugging cross-stage issues requires manual log correlation.
All 15 endpoints served at root path without version prefix.
No .pylintrc, ruff.toml, pyproject.toml [tool.ruff], or pre-commit hooks found.

recommendations.title: Add authentication to Flight SQL server
recommendations.description: The Flight SQL server accepts arbitrary SQL from any client. Add token-based auth using the same TokenStore as the REST API.

recommendations.title: Add circuit breakers to external dependencies
recommendations.description: Wrap Kafka producer and MinIO snapshot operations with circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures during sustained outages.

recommendations.title: Add distributed tracing
recommendations.description: Propagate W3C trace context through Kafka message headers. Add OpenTelemetry SDK to enable end-to-end tracing across all 27 consumers.

recommendations.title: Add rate limiting to API
recommendations.description: Add rate limiting middleware to prevent API abuse. Especially important for search and bulk endpoints.

recommendations.title: Add linting and formatting
recommendations.description: Add ruff configuration and pre-commit hooks for consistent code formatting across the monorepo.
